reviews.title: Regret Not Booking a Ferry
reviews.text: We paid and extra $100 in baggage fees because the carry on limit was 8kg… we were better off taking a ferry which was longer but A LOT cheaper. Don’t book with them please. Wish I could have canceled the flight last minute
reviews.author: Meagan B.

reviews.title: Terrible service!!!!
reviews.text: This airline is terrible!!! They cancelled the flight and just refunded the minimum. They don’t reply back to my emails even after 6 months!!! They go against the law by not refunding properly their customers. I should never have booked them. Real mistake
reviews.author: Sophie B

reviews.title: Bumpy ride and plane is very old
reviews.text: Plane is visibly old... I was scared that the plane might have metal fatigue from the looks of it. Further, our ride to Coron was very bumpy. Won't fly with Skyjet again Philippine Airlines or Cebu Pac are better options
reviews.author: Fatima B

reviews.title: Had no bad experience on this airline!
reviews.text: Much better than Airswift! smooth travel and ok staffs. Unfortunately they dont have flights to El Nido.
reviews.author: ms.anna

reviews.title: Horrible airline
reviews.text: The gate was still open and people were boarding the plane but they wouldn’t let us check in. There wasn’t a single person at the desk to help people. No one did anything about it to help us out as we were delayed from a previous flight. A lady came to “help” us but did nothing and continued to say that she had left the check in desk so there was nothing she could do. Useless and unhelpful.
reviews.author: Jacqui S

reviews.title: Despite bad reviews , our flights turned out okay
reviews.text: Flying from manila terminal 4 to Basuanga ,Coron. Seat is comfortable and spacious. 10kg check in baggage. Please pack carefully. Onboard baggage size has to be very small due to the height of the overhead cabin spaces.
reviews.author: TrailsOfAnne

reviews.title: Performed okay
reviews.text: Boarding started an hour late and the flight left 25 min late then arrived 40 min late. This was okay overall.
reviews.author: Brendan

reviews.title: A rowboat would be a more reliable form of transportation...
reviews.text: Flights are consistently delayed with no concern for customers. Our original flight from Manila to Coron was delayed 2 hours so when we asked for an earlier return flight to ensure we made out connection in Manila, we were told we need to pay a 4000 peso fee. When we asked if we could be refunded the fee due to the airline's incompetence, we were told that our flight was on time and there was nothing they could do. Skyjet is barely a company and it seems they make a majority of their money from screwing over it's customers. If I could give them 0 stars, I would gladly do it. AVOID!!!!
reviews.author: Connor C

reviews.title: If I could give ZERO rating, I would!
reviews.text: Skyjet has cancelled our flight due to bad weather. I was so puzzled as the other airlines arrived on time and everything went so smoothly. It was a nice sunny day, what a disappointment for them to cancel their fligt! But its their call so go on, we have rebooked our flight with another airline and fly on the same they when Skyjet cancelled their flight. Now, here we go, THE REFUND. Its been over a month now and still no refund. I have contacted them multiple times and always "PROCESSING". This is a complete joke, processing for a month for a refund?? and still waiting for the confirmation. You're the most unreliable airline and the worst customer service ever. We will never fly with you again!
reviews.author: Liezl

reviews.title: Cheap airline
reviews.text: Our flight was one of the many which was affected by the Taal volcanic eruption. The volcano erupted on the 12th of January, and our flight was on the 13th. We kept an eye on the news all night to see whether our flight will be cancelled. Our flight was at 10.30am, but from 3am we have been ringing the airline to see if they have any update on whether this will be cancelled. Their office in Manila could not be reached. I tried contacting them on facebook because they seem to be posting promotional adverts even at early hours of the morning. But just like the landline, no one was available to answer. We tried ringing the airport terminal, and we were told that all flights up to 11am will be cancelled, so we stayed at home for further update. We managed to get hold of someone from Skyjet at 8.15am. When I asked why was there no one answering their phone, the man I spoke with has said their office dont open until 8am. Bearing in mind that there was a natural disaster which could potentially affect the flights, they did not think of assigning someone to assist their worried passengers. Fortunately, we managed to get to the airport on time. To be fair, once we got to the airport, the airline personnels were very accommodating and friendly. It was a shame because their customer service was really good up until the disaster happened. Perhaps they should consider assigning someone to assist passenger in times like these. It is a shame because their service is actually very good
reviews.author: vida turingan

reviews.title: A bit of a greedy company
reviews.text: I organised a trip to the Philippines with my family this January. Part of the trip we booked a flight with Skyjet (3 passengers) A few days before the beginning of our trip there was the Taal vulcano explosion. The explosion was nowhere near Coron but all the trip had to be cancelled as news suggested things would get worst. So we decided to start cancelling our flights and hotels and look for alternatives. I contacted Skyjet. After the second email they contacted me informing that of the total amount I payed: PHP 18,744.72 they would refund me only: PHP 2,844.72. There is no way I can’t find here some sort level of greediness. The reputation of an airline is all about the way you respect and take care of your passengers and I will stay away from them in the future. KR I J Bastos
reviews.author: Jose Bastos

reviews.title: Chill!
reviews.text: Reading these scathing reviews before our flight, I was pretty put off! But went for it regardless as SkyJet offered the best timing for our trip. It was genuinely fine. Yes it was slightly delayed (less than an hour), and yes we had to pay 360 PHP per kg above the luggage limit (fine. That’s our fault for overpacking); but it was all good. I’d definitely fly with SkyJet again. FYI, You can purchase 20kg when you buy the flights. 800 PHP each. Job done.
reviews.author: James M

reviews.title: Flight on 10 passenger plane.
reviews.text: Small hopper plane. Long walk for tarmac boarding. No wheelchair assistance. only bisquiict and water served.
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.title: Fraud fraud and fraud
reviews.text: These company are completely scam and after your refund.Incase you have to cancel with in 5 minute .
reviews.author: Ali

reviews.title: refund ripoff policy
reviews.text: we cancelled our flight, but they charged us no show at the airport charges. ++ cancellation fee per way.
reviews.author: Lobsang S

reviews.title: Awful refund policy
reviews.text: Booked a flight from Coron to Manila on the website 2 pax with purchase of additional luggage allowance. Went to Cebuana shop to make a cash payment of 13,000 pesos, 1 day later our plans changed and no longer going to Coron island so emailed to cancel the flights. Was told that after all the charges and cancellation fees we would be getting 3,300 pesos back from our cash payment of 13,000 and on top of that it is not going to be paid out until 60 BANKING days (equivalents of 3 months) and will have to be collected from there airline office and payment is only by cheque. Now I understand I am the one canceling but after just 24 hours and 5 days until the flight this is just terrible. I have learnt the hard way, my message is if you book with them be certain you can fly on your dates as when you tour Palawan plans can and do change.
reviews.author: Gordon W

reviews.title: For a 9.8K PHP ticket ended up paying 15K PHP
reviews.text: If for any reason you card fails during online payment you are forced to do the entire process from the beginning.. and the tickets have gone up by a few hundred pesos. You are allowed to purchase extra luggage like I did but no more than 10kg (cost 800 PHP). You cannot purchase more. You are not notified of the airport cost for extra KG. At the airport you pay 360 PHP for each extra kilo. It is s rippoff. Nobody cares and you are blackmailed in paying thousands more. Scammers I DO NOT recommend this airline.
reviews.author: Fotis Routsis

reviews.title: SCAMMERS! Avoid!
reviews.text: These people are crooks, and will make you suffer until you are so desperate you will pay them. We arrived at the check in gate 1hr before our flight (there website states you need to be at the check in 45 minutes before). We were told we could not check in as the check in was closed. We couldn’t believe this - can they tell the time? Naturally, we kicked up a huge fuss. We THEN got told they had actually sold our seats to other people, and the flight was full. Excuse me?! We had booked the tickets months in advance. We had 2 international connecting flights to catch. We even demanded to watch (and we recorded) the CCTV footage of us arriving at check in on time, as they tried to argue that we were late. They knew they were wrong. They were even arguing about it between themselves. We were essentially begging them to do the right thing and get us our seats back (our seats, the ones we booked and paid for months ago). They then offered us another flight 3 hours later (we completely missed our connecting flights). After much complaining and deliberating, we knew we weren’t getting anywhere, so we said fine. They assured we would be priority on this flight and get us on straight away. Then it came to check in for THAT flight, and they said no we were actually on a waiting list, and would only get on if people did not show. We literally could not believe it, another 30 minutes of arguing. Luckily there were a few no shows, so we were ready to check in. THEY THEN SAID WE HAD TO PAY FOR THE TICKETS. Full price by the way. What? WHAT? After MUCH arguing we said FINE - we paid. We asked for a receipt to claim on travel insurance as we’d missed all other flights, and would have to not only re-purchase those for thousands of dollars, but get another hotel in the connecting city etc. Ha. They would not issue us a receipt. They couldn’t even hand write one. Know why? Because they are corrupt scammers who have no conscience. Absolutely disgusting. All they could say was “call our customer service”. Oh, just to top it off, they told another couple next to us (whose flight had been cancelled the previous day) that the flight was fully booked and they were not allowed on, despite having told them the previous day to come back and get this flight. We then got on the flight and there were ELEVEN available seats. I could not believe it. These people are disgusting. It’s a complete scam. Avoid at all costs people. Abhorrent, atrocious, unbelievable.
reviews.author: Jas

reviews.title: Avoid if at all possible!
reviews.text: Avoid these scam artists at all costs! They state they allow 1 checked bag per passenger with a weight limit of 10kg (about 20lbs) per bag. We each had 1 bag that was 10kg, but we also had a 3rd bag to check. I figured it would be an extra $25 or so to check it, but they charged $150 for it! I have since read they do this to non filipinos, so there may be discrimination involved (i.e. "skin tax). $150 was more than the bag and all its contents was worth, but once you are there, what can you do? On another note, they wait until 90 mins before departure before even showing up at the check in counter, so if you get to the airport early as you should, you will be waiting a while. They also apparently don't clean the plane between flights, as on our 45 min flight back to Manila, my wife and I both caught a nasty cold - and I very rarely get sick, so it must have been someone on the previous flight that left our seats covered in germs. On the plus side we got where we were going, which is the only reason I didn't give it 1 star. Conclusion: Do yourself a favor, fly with another airline so you don't get scammed for luggage fees and lessen your chance of being sick for half of your hard earned vacation.
reviews.author: husker3in4

reviews.title: DO NOT use Skyjet. They are terrible
reviews.text: We arrive at the airport and told the crew is late. So far, we have been delayed for over two hours for a 45 minute flight. They will not provide any updates. The weather is sunny and no rain delay. Now, they are saying maybe another crew will arrive. They refuse to book us on another carrier. Horrible and it’s ruining our leisure time. Recommend to go to another island because Sky Jet sucks.
reviews.author: Shawn W

reviews.title: Cheap and for those with no choice
reviews.text: Cabin crew looked lax and unaccommodating. Seats were worn and ride was bumpy the whole way, understandable during the weather. Mediocre, will only ride again if price of tickets are good.
reviews.author: Andrew John y Fernandes

reviews.title: Discrimination
reviews.text: The check in clerk most obviously hates non Filipinos. I had carefully checked the baggage restrictions and sizes. She refused my carry on as to big. I pointed out the sixes as per the printed ticket, I asked to see the size cage, she refused and said I cannot board unless I check my carry on bag in the hold. I reluctantly agreed, she then said an extra hold bag is extra and I was over weight on my check in luggage. I was completely with weight and size according to there own website. I had no choice but to pay. $200. Twice the cost of the ticket. But wait Filipinos were loading bags on, no charge, carry on twice my bag size, no charge. But then just to add insult to injury the 146 seater plane only had 26 passengers, 25 Filipinos and me, more than enough room for my carry on. Blatant racism and discrimination
reviews.author: Philip S

reviews.title: Batanes vacay
reviews.text: It's a smooth flight to/from Batanes. Nice plane and comfortable seats. Flight attendants are very attentive to the needs of passengers. Though ticket fare may be expensive, we just need to check out on promos thats within your budget.
reviews.author: joy

reviews.title: TO BE AVOIDED
reviews.text: Worst experience ever. Flights got cancelled twice due to a slight rain ( while Cebu and Philipppine airlines were flying)and we had to postpone with a surcharge our outbound flight from Manila to Europe because we have to stay one more night in coron.(of which 12 hrs in that warehouse called busu anca airport).We were told that their planes are bigger but older and not equipped properly to withstand landing with light rain. From what i’ve Seen also other airlines like air swift are not equipped. Customer service?!? Totally missing.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.title: Update re Refund!!!
reviews.text: We got our REFUND like last month! Thanks Skyjet! Though my brother and I did not expect it at all (we have up already) since it feels like forever waiting, we still appreciate it. I think if you have lots of time, just keep on calling them. But still not to expect too much. Expectation realy hurts. Again thanks Skyjet!
reviews.author: Anna Angela

reviews.title: DON’T FLY SKYJET
reviews.text: This is a WTF Moment. I thought skyjet airlines was decent, until the end of my vacation. We were supposed to fly from Coron to Manila and then stay for 2 nights at Manila and fly back to the states. It was a nightmare. We were stuck at the pre-departure gate at USU (Coron airport) waiting for our flight. It said that the aircraft will come in 15 minutes, or what I thought it would be. 15 minutes came to 30, 30 to an hour, and then it said that our flight had been canceled, JUST BECAUSE OF A LITTLE RAIN. We ended up having to talk to the agent over and they said they had nothing to do. We ended up being at standby for quite some time. Waiting for the next 2 skyjet flights, skyjet was like, nah fam. Both flights canceled, and we ended up staying the night at Coron. Next day, we were at the airport again. The next skyjet flight was at 1pm while at standby. We ended up having to book through Philippine airlines. Supposing we had booked it the day of the skyjet cancelations before. We ended up being on standby for both Skyjet and Philippine airlines. Skyjet has a few standby passengers on the flight. We ended up not being in the skyjet flight because it was full. But, THANK YOU PHILIPPINE AIRLINES. We got the PAL flight to Clark (Neighboring city near Manila) the people at the Philippine airlines counter helped us out to get on that flight. So Thanks PAL. Never fly Skyjet.
reviews.author: Nico Ylarde

reviews.title: Do not book with this Airline
reviews.text: I don’t recomend under any circumstance to book with this airline. Worst airline customer service in my life even when flight had weather conditions cancelations.
reviews.author: ariannachagollan

reviews.title: Flight was punctual, on time and this set my mind at ease.
reviews.text: Short 45 minutes flight. Beautiful to sit at the window and see all the small islands below. Flight was on time. Staff at check-in was friendly and the process was done quickly.
reviews.author: Holidayjunkie2015

reviews.title: Don’t Ever Book with Skyjet!!!
reviews.text: Horrible customer service, stay away even if they have ANY kind of Promotions. They will only give you a bad experience. They will Cancel your flight and giving you a run around when returning your money. It’s going on 2 months now. Trust me it’s not worth it. My vacation was ruined and they don’t feel any sense of remorse regarding my situation. I came back to Cali with an awful memory of my vacation because of this Airline Skyjet .
reviews.author: Elaine D

reviews.title: Worst airlines ever
reviews.text: You standard hand carry is not for this airlines So they forced us to check the bag and charges the excess baggage 350 pedis for kilo and the pain an ungodly amount, we could’ve flown another airlines, you do not save in the long run do not ever fly this airline ever wears every airline in the world what a joke
reviews.author: gregoryh828

reviews.title: THE WORST!!
reviews.text: The worst airline and a cheat. When I purchased my tickets I didn't buy the luggage allowance as I am not sure if we will have more than the allowed. Prior to our flight, I tried to call/chat their customer service line but no luck. Long story short, we're asked to pay $300/bag for our excess even after I explained that I tried calling prior to our flight. They even asked me for evidence if, I really did call ( the nerve!). Arguments went on / I made a scene for everyone to hear how bad their customer service was. Because we refused to pay they offered another deal. Our bags will not be in the same flight but the next day early AM flight and will only have to pay $50 ( what a scam!!) The following day we received our luggages with extra luggage (not ours). Skyjet did not call nor know that they were missing another passenger's luggage. After our 3 day trip, there still no call from Skyjet about the missing luggage. We brought the luggage back to the airport and guess what? Skyjet did not even thank us or compensate us for our kindness. STRESS IN EVERY ANGLE! I will never use Skyjet ever again! Yes, it is a cheap airline but if you add the scams they will pull at the check-in counter you'll be paying just as much plus the stress! The plane is old and scary to be in.. AVOID THIS AIRLINE.
reviews.author: JStubb92025

reviews.title: REFUND takes years to process
reviews.text: This airline takes forever to process a refund. Tried calling them and they kept on saying it is still in-process. It has been past 2 months already. DON'T BOOK ON THIS AIRLINE!
reviews.author: Al Galarosa

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: My wife and I visited coron for a great vacation we used Skynet out of Manila to get there and the service was great no problem with check in very friendly staff nice and helpful unfortunately on the return leg back to Manila was a different story the lady who was at check-in tried to charge us for additional luggage of 2kilo despite our total luggage weight was actually 8kg under weight she tried to say that our carryon was too big for the plane despite the fact that we already flew to coron from Manila with the same bags and so she wanted to check the bags in and charge us for excess we refused this and eventually she let us take 1 of the bags onboard when onboard the very friendly hostess had no issue with the bag size as it fitted easily into the locker with room to spare I don't feel like this is particularly a airline issue as such it appears that the person involved was not being reasonable and not doing the right thing by either myself or her employer I will fly with this airline again however I will certainly be looking out for this type of issue in the future I hope it is a 1 of issue that needs to be addressed
reviews.author: Mark B

reviews.title: Steven Hillier
reviews.text: I was given no notice of flight cancellation until at airport ! They certainly could have emailed me ! They presented me with a release form that was comparable to less $40 us dollars per ticket releasing them of all liabilities .An article was in the paper a few days later explaining exactly what I went through that day and how they felt practices like this had Banned other airlines from operating at certain airports ! That the author believed the release forms were sleazy and not legal . They said I could book a ticket on other airlines for that same day for double the price . That’s all they could do !! I had to contact them for a refund if I wanted one which I have done and know I am now being told via email they will be holding onto my money for 30/60 days . Buyer be ware as this airline customer service is as bad as it gets !
reviews.author: DayTrip263039

reviews.title: Money Grabbing Thieves !!!
reviews.text: Been stung by these money grabbing opportunists/thieves twice now. 2 Kgs over weight in checked in luggage, and they couldn't ask for the 720 PHP any faster ! Nevermind the locals taking on massive carry on bags that should have been checked in, purely on their size, along with commercial quantities of Krispy Kremes. Let's sting the tourist instead ! SJ are nearly twice as dear as Cebu Pacific as well. Never again.
reviews.author: David E

reviews.title: Bad Service
reviews.text: Our flight was cancelled and I think that would be their last flight from Siargao, they didn't help us to book for another flight neither an hotel accommodation. Left us hanging, I don't recommend this airline.
reviews.author: VicYutuc

reviews.title: Avoid this company!
reviews.text: Our flight from Coron to Manila was cancelled, the check-in counter didn’t support at all. They leave us alone in the middle of nowhere. The first available direct flight was in 3 days with Skyjet. They are not IATA airlines so we haven’t the right we have in Europe with all the carrier (assistance and seats in the first flight available). In order to reach Manila airport for our return flight to Italy we had to buy 900€ tickets (2 people) for the following day with Philippines Airlines (Coron-Cebu) and Air Asia (Cebu-Manila). Philippines Airlines ticket office staff in Coron supported really a lot, thank you! If you are lucky, you can save something with Skyjet tickets but if something goes wrong it can be really frustrating. It seems that they cancel the flights very often in Coron. After 60 days they finally refund us and not at 100%!! I’ll strongly suggest to avoid this company if you want to have a safe trip.
reviews.author: Babbaiser

reviews.title: TERRIBLE, AVOID !!!
reviews.text: This was the nightmare of my life. First, i came to Athens airport at night time. Tried to get check in in internet, not working. No one at front desk. No boarding pass, no access to lounge. I was waiting 4 hours before the laziest young girl in planet came to skyjet desk. In not polite tone told me to wait until she open computer. It took 25 minits. TWENTY FIVE MINITS. Rest you can imagine yourself. I was so disappointed that i took a catamaran boat back to Athens rathen than use my return ticket with this company. My advise, rent a boat and row to island, do not use this company.
reviews.author: hoikkis

reviews.title: Efficient, hassle free way to travel to Coron.
reviews.text: From standing in the queue to check-in until boarding the flight I was surprised by the efficient friendly manner in which I was treated. Check-in was efficient with friendly, competent staff. It is just a pity that the flight was delayed by about 50 minutes.
reviews.author: Holidayjunkie2015

reviews.title: Unprofessional and unreliable
reviews.text: Cancelled flight for a bit of rain... Straight after sun shines!!! Customer care and land staff completely untrained!! Totally avoid this airline. Also they don't really know their own procedures for cancellations!!
reviews.author: Matteo I

reviews.title: I will never ever fly Skyjet again!
reviews.text: I tried Skyjet for a trip to Busuanga as I thought it would be a cheaper alternative to PAL and Cebu Pacific. I was dead wrong as I ended up spending almost an additional 200% on TOP of the original Skyjet flight cost. Let me explain. - The baggage allowance is just 10kgs per person so I was charged 3150 pesos for extra baggage of 9 kgs (for 2 people) - The 3:10 Busuanga-Manila flight was cancelled and passengers were moved to the 4:10 flight. However, the 4:10 flight was then delayed by almost 2 hours. Skyjet staff in Busuanga tried to assure me that I will get on-ground support in Manila so that I won’t miss my 7:25 pm Singapore connecting flight. However, the flight landed at 6:30 pm and I did not receive any support at all so I ended up missing my flight. I had to scramble and book for a new flight the same night as my husband had an important appointment the next day. The stress and worry tarnished an otherwise fantastic holiday in Coron. Skyjet, if you are reading this, please clean up your act. You boast of having the most number of daily flights to Coron but if you cancel a third of these flights anyway due to “reduced flight frequency”, then you are just antagonising Coron visitors.
reviews.author: Rowena

reviews.title: good for a small airline Just luggage problems
reviews.text: For a tiny airline operating to the outer islands this was very good, all staff were helpful and the aircraft Ba146 although old was fine, The only problem is the checked baggage allowance is 10kg and 7kg for hand luggage they do weigh everything the cost of excess is ridiculous for 11kg extra the cost was $80USD nearly as much as the airfare. but a good way to get to an interesting island.
reviews.author: Dennis

reviews.title: horrible customer service and cancellation policy
reviews.text: I had cancelled my family's flight on February 7, 2018. I only received a respond after several follow up emails, stating that they are deducting cancellation fee AND refund fee (usually, I only have to pay the cancellation fee). In short, I'm getting back approximately 13% of what I paid for. Then, I was informed that I will receive refund 30-60 bank days. After 60days, I haven't receive my refund or any information regarding it. I had to email them, and was informed that they are forwarding it to the Refund team (which I feel should have been processed when I requested for it). Then, I emailed them back about my comment on their customer service but have not heard anything back. Based on other's reviews, I might not get my refund for 1-2 more months (which would put it to 4-6month since I requested for the cancellation/refund). Please review your Refund Policy and Customer Service Process, because it lessens the trust on the company when you don't do what you said you are going to do.
reviews.author: Czarina

reviews.title: Stay away at all cost- they are crooks
reviews.text: Even if it is cheaper, even if it is faster and more convenient, do not fly this airline. To simply put it they are crooks. I booked 4 tickets online, I got issued two tickets for every passenger on the same flight on the same day. This should be the simplest case to issue a refund. They refuse by email and phone to refund the double booking, after going in person to their office on Manila airport hey agreed to refund but never actually did it. They rely on you giving up. If it was in any other country then Philippines they would not get away with it. Btw, reading reviews now, it seems the same situation happened to other people. Absolutely avoid.
reviews.author: wal

reviews.title: The worst airline i have ever seen
reviews.text: One word sums it all: terrible. 3 hours delay, no information, no compensation. Avoid like the plague!
reviews.author: Victor B

reviews.title: Pricey
reviews.text: One of the smallest plane we flew on., its kinda costly with skyjet to Coron. Flights were on time both ways. Smooth take off and landing. Luggage allowance at 10kg and 5kg on hand luggage and they're not strict that we gone a little over that. So overall a great 1st experience.
reviews.author: Sant1 Chr1s

reviews.title: Skyjet will mess up your travel itinerary
reviews.text: What can go wrong with an old plane? It's going to conk out sooner than later. What can go wrong with a small airline company? When their old plane conks out, they leave their passengers to fend for themselves. This basically sums up what Skyjet did to us. Our flight out of Basco was cancelled because their plane needed some serious repairs and it turned out that the airline company was the one that need more serious repairs. They did nothing to help the passengers and offered to give them P2,000 each so they will not file a complaint. No help in giving accommodation. No help to book them in other airlines. No help to even think about sending an extra flight for the stranded passengers. My tip? Forget about this airline. Skyjet will mess up your travel itinerary. They don't care about their passengers although they charge the highest plane fares for that route. I'd give them a negative rating (if that were possible here).
reviews.author: vansky

reviews.title: Never fly on this airline
reviews.text: Don't make this airline part of your travel arrangements no matter what the travel agent tells you. This airline will take your money and leave you all alone when there's a problem. Our flight back to Manila was cancelled due to aircraft problems - not because of the weather or other acts of God. Do you think that the airline would care enough to do something for their stranded passengers? No! They can't even give a decent answer to the many inquiries from the affected travelers. For us in our party, we had to spend an extra 4 days in Basco because of Skyjet's inaction and ineptitude. In fact, we had to book our tickets from other airlines just to go back to Manila. Oh, and it would take at least 30 days to get a refund from Skyjet for their cancelled flight. Talk about rubbing salt to the wound. The staff are not trained to handle crisis situations. During the time when passengers were asking about what will happen next, all the staff in Basco disappeared (they practically hid somewhere and closed their office). I'm wondering why this airline is even allowed to operate if that is how they treat their customers. Don't fall for the line that they have the fastest flight from Manila to Batanes. You're better off taking the bigger airlines because they take care of their passengers. Skyjet has not even apologized for the major inconvenience they caused to their passengers. Never fly on this airline if you want to enjoy your trip.
reviews.author: Van A

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN!
reviews.text: This was my first time to book a flight with this airline (definitely the last!). I booked a flight to Siargao last year and then a few days back, I got a message saying they are currently undertaking flight upgrades (doesn’t make sense) and in line with that, my flight is cancelled. They are only giving me options to refund or to reroute my flight to only one place (Busuanga) which I have no plans to visit as of now. So I asked them how can I refund. Lo and behold, it can only be refunded at their Skyjet corporate office located at MIAA! I will never book a flight with this airline ever again! Very unprofessional!
reviews.author: Kate

reviews.title: An absolute joke of an airline- save yourself time and money and do NOT book with Skyjet
reviews.text: We were already sceptical when we arrived at the airport as our friends flight with Skyjet the previous day was cancelled (no help or alternatives offered). Upon arrival we were told our flight was delayed by 1 and a half hours. That time came and went and with no updates we approached stage desk again, this time they said 2-3 hour delay, this continued throughout the day with no updates and having to ask the extremely rude and unhelpful staff who then seemed to make up a number. 6 hours later we have missed our connecting flight to Bali. When asked about compensation all Skyjet could reply with was ‘no compensation’. No apology, no explanation. We had to pay for our missed accommodation in Bali, and for a hotel in Manila. As well as extremely expensive flights to Bali the next day. All because of Skyjets incompetence. This seems to be happening to people again and again. They should not be allowed to continue as an airline.
reviews.author: Emily V
